sections.title: Scope and eligibility

sections.text: Your Explorer name is visible in crossplay sessions and is shared by linked platforms. You can change it 30 days after signup or your last change. Do not impersonate others, disclose private information about other people, harass or threaten players, cheat, disrupt sessions, or evade bans. You keep your rights in original content you share and permit us and the session host to store, show, and share it as needed to operate and moderate the session.

sections.text: Independent server operators and co-op hosts manage their own rules, access, and saves. They can kick or ban players, reset worlds, and configure when inactive claims and settlements become accessible to others. Imponix may restrict services it operates for serious or repeated violations or to protect users and services. You can ask about an Imponix restriction at contact@imponix.com.

sections.text: My World is in development. Updates may change features, compatibility, and save formats. Online services may be interrupted or discontinued. Keep copies of local saves and worlds you host. Purchases and refunds are handled by the storefront under its rules and applicable law.

The French version applies where required by law. For questions, email contact@imponix.com.

Vous pouvez le modifier 30 jours après l’inscription ou la dernière modification. L’usurpation d’identité, la divulgation de renseignements privés sur autrui, le harcèlement, les menaces, la tricherie, la perturbation des sessions et le contournement des bannissements sont interdits. Vous pouvez écrire à contact@imponix.com au sujet d’une restriction imposée par Imponix.
